desc: The Pump Action Field Walnut 12GA is an efficient and reliable no-nonsense 12GA Pump Action shotgun. It features a lightweight aluminum receiver with a 5 + 1 capacity. Packaged elegantly with Walnut finish. 26" barrel reamed for full. Full, Modified, and improved choke tubes making this a hunting shotgun that can approach any situation. Chambered for both 2 3/4" and 3"shotshells.
